expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the cards are not aligned to a common baseline. The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card's image starts and ends lower than its neighbours, so its title and delivery-fee text sit roughly 27px below the corresponding text of 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol…'. The Green Bowl Poké image is also shorter than the other tiles, producing a ragged row.
The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: the first is a plain white outline heart with no backdrop, while the second sits on a dark filled circle.

The time badges inside the carousel cards are positioned inconsistently — '15–25 min' on the Green Bowl Poké card is vertically higher relative to its image than the '20–30 min' badges on the other cards.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 directly describes the carousel cards, including the middle card, being vertically misaligned with their neighbors.
